propositions: sign-review deterministically fails with store-read-failure when untracked files exist in .tickets-tracker, despite plan passing review, because resign.py:146 omits ignore_untracked flag when calling generation.collect
orchestrator.py:650 silently falls back to full LLM re-review instead of cheap drift probe when untracked tracker files exist, due to ignore_untracked defaulting to False
attest.py:139 and attest.py:406 abort signing on fallback paths when ignore_untracked is not passed to collect_plan_relation_snapshot
untracked files in shared .tickets-tracker block signing for all concurrent sessions on the machine, creating race conditions under normal concurrent writer operation

fix passes ignore_untracked=True at four call sites (resign.py, orchestrator.py, attest.py x2) to make signing tolerant of unrelated untracked tracker files while preserving strictness for tracked dirty state
